zh-CN:
更新内容
• 新增土耳其语界面
• 播放进度条采用全新紧凑样式，右侧改显示剩余时间
• 本地与 WebDAV 的同名专辑合并为一张专辑，详情页显示来自全部来源的歌曲
• WebDAV 来源实时显示在线状态：离线来源的曲目弱化显示、需联网的操作自动置灰，来源卡片常驻显示曲目数；完整缓存的歌曲不受影响，离线也能正常播放
• WebDAV 断流恢复后从上次进度继续播放，不再从头开始
• 修复 WebDAV 网络歌曲响度偏低的问题
• 修复完整缓存歌曲被来源探活误停、待播期间点击暂停无效的问题
• WebDAV 启动扫描在服务端无变化时不再刷新曲库列表，消除列表闪烁
• 协议同意记录迁移至「文档\OriginalSoundPlayer\Agreement」，升级后需重新确认一次用户协议
en:
Release Notes
• Added a Turkish interface
• Refreshed compact playback progress bar; the right side now shows the remaining time
• Identically named local and WebDAV albums merge into one album, with details listing songs from all sources
• WebDAV sources now show live online status: tracks from offline sources are dimmed with online-only actions disabled, and source cards always show their track count; fully cached tracks are unaffected and still play offline
• After a stream drop, WebDAV playback resumes from the last position instead of starting over
• Fixed WebDAV tracks playing too quietly
• Fixed fully cached tracks being interrupted by source probes and pause not responding while the next track was pending
• WebDAV startup scans no longer refresh the library when nothing changed on the server, eliminating list flicker
• The agreement acceptance record moves to Documents\OriginalSoundPlayer\Agreement — you will be asked to confirm the agreement once after updating
